text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Now, next to appear—these two everyone’s been waiting for! Vodka, and Daiwa Scarlet!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks for havin’ me...! Yo Scarlet, you ready to lose to me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, the only thing I’m ready for is making *you* cry! Ahem… everyone! Please cheer for me today!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Listen to this roaring applause! These two represent the current Umamusume racing world, and without a doubt, they’re today’s biggest spotlight!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: This isn’t the full preparation they’d have for the Twinkle Series, but I’m sure they’ll show us something magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: But—despite that! Even so, the one proudly declaring she “won’t give up victory”… is this rising star of an Umamusume…!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’m Buena Vista. I’ve trained my hardest for today! Please... cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo, Buena Vista!! Do your beeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! This level of expectation and attention—so hard to believe it's toward a pre-debut Umamusume! What kind of run will she show us!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each time she smiles from atop the paddock, the crowd erupts. After watching that scene closely—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are…! You said you wanted to talk before heading to the course… what’s wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While speaking, I stand directly before her—just one small step closer than usual. Then, looking straight into her eyes, I gently speak.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Before you go, let’s take a moment to focus...</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Focus…?
choice_data_list: <size=32>Yeah. Just try listening to only my voice...</size>
<size=32>Yeah. Just try listening to only my voice...</size>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Umamusume have exceptional hearing. Even from this underground approach tunnel, they can clearly hear the cheers outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But even with that powerful hearing, they have “directionality.” So I call to her slowly, clearly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …h… fuuuuuu……

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh. I…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …I just realized. I was really nervous, wasn’t I?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! …Hehe, yeah, I have. The crowd’s energy totally overwhelmed me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But I’m okay now! Thank you, I’m heading out. —I’ll win, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then… the long-awaited event-specific competition finally began.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah… Hah—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: From the start, Daiwa Scarlet smoothly takes the lead! What a brilliant position! She’s firmly taking control of the pace!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Stay calm. Save your legs, and if you bring it to a final burst— “You can fight even against Daiwa Scarlet”!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Stay calm. Save your legs, and if you bring it to a final burst— “You can fight even against Daiwa Scarlet”!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, LET’S GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Vodka-chan’s explosive final burst… is terrifying! But she wobbles a bit sometimes… that’s why!!)
choice_data_list: <size=32>There’s a gap to aim at! Go, Buena—!!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaah…!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet in the lead! Vodka is chasing hard!! But—but Buena Vista! Buena Vista is coming too!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: 200m left—will it be Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet, or Buena Vista!? Buena Vista is closing in! The finish line is right there—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (It hurts… but I won’t give in! I want to win, I *want* to win!! Here… just here—!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaa…!!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Seriously. To get within a nose of those monsters… She’s still ridiculous. …She really entertains, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sure she was amazing before, but wasn’t she extra amazing today!? Isn’t it obviously thanks to *that* person!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes. Buena… hehe, I see. I felt a sacred guiding light just now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Even so, my story won’t stop. Hehehehe…♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fuu…… —It’s over, huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I simply nod. My planning was naive—nothing more. As regret and guilt swell, just as I open my mouth to apologize—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …I’m frustrated. So frustrated, really…!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I wanted to! Just today—just today, I *really* wanted to win. So I could show you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I’m frustrated, frustrated! I wanted to show you! That with you—*because* it’s with you, I can win!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I wanted… to show you…!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a while, she cries and cries. As if… returning to those childhood days. And then—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Remember what I said before? When you asked me about the “scenery” I dreamed of reaching.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That I would definitely reach that dream scenery. That I never once doubted it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Do you know why I never doubted?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Do you know why I believed I could run in a way that everyone would love, that everyone would cheer for?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —It’s because *you* were always there!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Always, always—you were obsessed with my running. Always, always—you cheered your heart out for me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even when we grew up, even when we were apart— you stayed deep inside my heart, always.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …So, you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I finally understand. Once again… she was ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She already saw the answer we were supposed to reach. Even though I’m older… I feel a bit ashamed, and then I open my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once more. As many times as needed. To catch up to her running ahead, so I can support her back.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Buena, let me say it again. With me—!</size>
<size=32>Buena, let me say it again. With me—!</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then—tap. …Her gently extended fingertip lightly touches my lips.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Sorry. Can I ask for one selfish thing?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If we’re redoing it, I want it from the very beginning. …Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so—once again. Facing her at the promised place.
choice_data_list: <size=32>Sorry to keep you, Buena. With me—</size>
<size=32>Sorry to keep you, Buena. With me—</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Okay!
choice_data_list: <size=32>Will you enter a full contract with me?</size>
<size=32>Will you enter a full contract with me?</size>

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yes, absolutely. My Trainer!
